meta.title: Investors — PeopleArt
meta.description: Invest in Peopleart Pty Ltd — the IP holding company behind Propiología. Learn our investment thesis and access the Data Room.

hero.title: Invest in the Science of Human Potential
hero.subtitle: Peopleart Pty Ltd is the Australian company that owns the intellectual property behind Propiología — a proprietary framework operating at the intersection of behavioral science, enterprise training, and personal transformation software.

thesis.title: Investment Thesis
thesis.body: We sit at the convergence of three high-growth markets: enterprise L&D (USD 370B), behavioral science technology, and personal development software. Our proprietary Propiología methodology — protected by trade secrets and a decade of applied research — provides a defensible moat in a market hungry for evidence-based human development solutions.

items.title: Enterprise Training
items.body: The six artistic archetypes delivered as workshops, facilitated programs, and leadership intensives. Direct B2B sales to corporations, hospital networks, and universities.

items.title: SaaS Platform
items.body: propiology.com — a B2C and B2B subscription platform built on the Propiología methodology for personal and organisational transformation. Recurring revenue, global reach.

items.title: IP Licensing
items.body: The Propiología framework licensed to HR tech companies, coaching platforms, and corporate training providers. Asset-light, high-margin revenue stream.
